limitations: UI fixtures are real attachments opened as unloaded tabs; this suite does not claim PDF rendering, a physical drag, or full workspace restoration.
Remote repository notices are removed only in the isolated test harness to prevent a native Word integration notice from stealing focus.
Zotero 8/9, macOS and Linux were not runtime-tested for this version.

candidateAttempt.note: An earlier candidate failed the full-PDF missing-group reopen check. Late tab item-identifier handling was subsequently fixed and covered by modern/legacy feature tests.
